# SBC MassPay

> Send payments to multiple recipients with zero gas fees, powered by SBC.
> Part of The Stable Coin Company (stablecoin.xyz).

Batch up to 200 recipients in one UserOperation on Base.
The SBC Paymaster sponsors all gas. No native tokens needed.

- Docs: https://docs.stablecoin.xyz/use-cases/mass-payment
- Website: https://stablecoin.xyz
- GitHub: https://github.com/stablecoinxyz
